# Version 4.157.0
> **Skia m157 rendering corrections** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157 updates to Skia m157 with raster, glyph and GPU rendering corrections. The line also makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. Later collected fixes improve reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and affected Vulkan device-loss cleanup without changing managed API signatures.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m157 with unchanged managed signatures** — Updates the native renderer to milestone 157 while retaining the existing binding surface and glyph-bounds guard. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200; native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct raster bounds and GPU transfers** — Fixes convex antialiased path overflow across clip gaps, Ganesh device-space bounds and coverage-mask clamping, Graphite clip-key packing and wedge inflation, and alpha-to-RGBx readback stride. Also initializes Vulkan render-pass pointers correctly. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **Validated glyph replay** — Validates direct-mask Slug data during deserialization and drawing, and corrects unsupported fractional replay so unsuitable glyph data does not bypass rendering constraints. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **Stable hairlines and text-atlas selection** — Corrects oversized square caps on zero-length hairlines under reflected transforms and guards non-finite cap calculations. Rounds Ganesh atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong texture for ordinary and LCD text. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670))
- **Targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround** — Adds a 1 ms delay on affected Ganesh and Graphite device-loss cleanup paths for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56. The integration review did not specifically establish affected physical-device behavior. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670))
- **Explicit cdecl imports** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching DllImport and delegate paths across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. This addresses an ABI mismatch relevant to Windows x86; runtime verification of the reported optimized-call stack growth remains outstanding. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly specify cdecl, matching the existing import and delegate conventions. Package revision 14.4.0.200 does not upgrade the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine.

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m157, corrects raster and GPU readback behavior, and validates glyph replay. It also makes LibraryImport declarations explicitly cdecl; HarfBuzzSharp's 14.4.0.200 package revision retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
